description:
The USDA Forest Service (USFS) intends on awarding a competitive BPA Call Order against the BPA for 12444726Q0020 - Reforestation NNIS BPA for Francis Marion Sumter (FMS) National Forest & Savannah River Site (SRS), SC.

Location:   Sumter National Forest, 20 Work Center Road, Whitmire, SC 29178               

This is not a solicitation.  This synopsis notification of intent to award a BPA Call order does not constitute a request for proposals or submission of any information in response to this notification.

This procurement is restricted to those approved companies eligible for call orders under the Reforestation NNIS BPA for Francis Marion Sumter (FMS) National Forest & Savannah River Site (SRS), SC for USFS.
